Definition: from G1909 and G3062; left over, i.e. remaining:--rest.
BiblicalUsage: Epiloipos means the rest, what remains — and Peter says we should no longer live the rest of our time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
TheologicalSignificance: The past is past, and what remains is to be lived to the will of God — that is the real question of the rest of my time.
